svg.aria-label: Meeting Tycoon — a satirical corporate management sim
svg.title: Meeting Tycoon
svg.desc: Hero banner: a full-week corporate calendar absurdly overbooked, with crisis-red Wednesday, a lone Focus-Time slot on Friday, and two notification toasts bursting out — "CEO Added a Quick Sync" and "Approval needed."

g.text: Schedule meetings. Survive politics. Maintain the illusion.
You're the new manager. You have 5 accept slots a day.
25 days to the Promotion. Or the Performance Improvement Plan.
87% TIME IN MEETINGS · 2% ON ACTUAL WORK · 1 INEVITABLE PROMOTION
